newsitem.title: UK: Cardinal Business chief Baldwin to resign.
newsitem.headline: Cardinal Business chief Baldwin to resign.

text.p: Cardinal Business Group said on Tuesday that its chairman and chief executive Alan Baldwin and sales and marketing director Paul Baldwin are resigning from the board with immediate effect.
Both were leaving to pursue other business interests, the company said in a statement.
Nat Solomon, who has been non-executive director of the company since September 1992, has been appointed non-executive chairman.
The company has appointed Andrew Ducker as chief executive, the statement said. Cardinal would soon appoint a finance director.
The resignations of Alan and Paul Baldwin would involve compensation for loss of office of 200,000 stg each. The company said these payments would be funded by the issue of 1.31 million shares.
